provenance_note: Households use 2020-2024 ACS B19001; population uses B01003; workers and commute modes use B08301 for Manhattan Census Tracts 238.02, 238.03 and 238.04, the three-tract Roosevelt Island proxy. Approximate 90% MOEs: 5,175 households ±514; 11,520 residents ±1,071; 5,696 workers ±680; 1,265 worked from home ±337. ACS direct-mode estimates are Subway 3,060, Bus 165 and Ferry 119. The displayed demand overlay applies the selected peak-hour share to those ACS usual-commute estimates; it is not observed ridership and excludes Tram demand because ACS does not identify Tram riders separately. ACS Rail is excluded from independent RI capacity because there is no commuter-rail boarding service on the island; first-leg access is unknown. The household-size conversion uses the household-weighted 2020-2024 ACS B25010 average of 2.087 people per occupied household (approximate MOE ±0.141, holding weights fixed). Current B01003 population includes group-quarters residents; added households are converted using occupied-household size. The selected weekday 07:00-08:00 schedule has 8 southbound M trains (1,100 passengers/train retained as the spec planning capacity at your direction) and 4 Q102 departures to Queens. The Astoria Ferry has 3 island departures, represented by a 20-minute equivalent headway despite irregular actual gaps. Whole-weekday totals use scheduled Roosevelt Island-to-off-island departures on 2026-10-21: 115 M and 37 F trains, 47 Q102 buses, 109 Tram trips, and 39 Astoria Ferry sailings. The user-provided 2,100-passenger F capacity is applied to the F night trips; all service-day totals are schedules, not verified operations.
